fixed: The question came up only as the narrator said its words at the end of the line, after 4 s, over a shot of legs; it is up within the first second now, over the whole bathroom, clear of the face.
The scale's number ran into its KG; the number and the KG have their own places in the bubble.
Close in on the blob of fat, the room behind vanished into the dark hall; the bathroom wall stays behind it now.
The blob broke into loose dots that read as nothing; it breaks into small fat molecules, chains of carbon and hydrogen with an oxygen at one end, that stay on screen as the camera dives on.
The fat cells were drawn outside the skin, a stiff column like a corn cob; they lie under the skin and the hoodie now, a little out of line and of different sizes.
The single fat cell sat on a muddy olive ground; its neighbours show round it, and the oil fills the screen only once the camera is inside the drop.
The face from the side was a triangle nose and a dot eye; it has a forehead, nose, lips and chin, the channel's round eye and the mascot's afro.
The ENERGY sign was cut by the edge; the signs stand over their holders, inside the picture.
Diving into the belly showed 0.7 s of plain pink, and the camera went in at the trousers; it goes in at the hoodie through a rush of cells and fat, never empty for more than 0.3 s.
notes: One journey, Biku's script as written: the question over your bathroom, the scale ticking from 72.0 to 71.0 as a blob of fat lifts off and vanishes; back over a hall of experts (doctors, dietitians, trainers, each named), a red cross over most of them and green ticks over three; their signs ENERGY, HEAT, MUSCLE and one pointing at the toilet; back into the blob, which comes apart into fat molecules; into your belly, the fat cells under the skin, one cell and its drop of oil; FAT IS MADE OF with carbon, hydrogen and oxygen named; up to your nose with oxygen streaming in. Measured: never empty, never still.
